 retailers create personalized, connected experiences without extra
 tools or added complexity.

One platform, 
every layer connected
 
 
 
 
 
 
Unified customer insights
 
Captures cross-channel transactional and behavioral data into unified 360ᵒ profiles. Turn data into insights with predictive analytics, AI-assisted trend detection, and dynamic clustering.
 
Explore CDP →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
AI brain for retail
 
The intelligent core that understands context and intent. Menura AI learns your brand data, understands product context, and interprets customer behavior to power real-time, human-like conversations that personalize every journey.
 
Explore Menura AI →
 
 
 
 
 
 
Customer engagement engine
 
Set up automated customer journey flows. Identify key segments, trigger messages based on behavior, and deliver the right experience at the right moment, all without manual effort.
 
Explore Customer Engagement →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Built-in channels, all in one place
 
Engage customers directly across every major channel, natively integrated and automatically synchronized. No external tools or integrations needed; every touchpoint stays consistent and on-brand.
 
See all our channels →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Built for the 
future customer journey
 
From first click to lifelong loyalty, ContactPigeon powers smarter interactions that feel personal, at every touchpoint.
 
 
View All Use Cases →
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
PRODUCT DISCOVERY
 
Product guidance like a pro
 
AI guides shoppers to the right items, compares offers, and triggers real-time personalized product suggestions that increase add-to-cart rates.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
OFFERS & PROMOTIONS
 
Offers that feel personal
 
No more generic discounts. ContactPigeon identifies each customer's motivation, and delivers tailored offers - increasing redemption without unnecessary margin erosion.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
CUSTOMER RETENTION
 
Grow loyalty on autopilot
 
After the first sale, ContactPigeon uses AI predictions to assess when customers are likely to return, or drift away, and delivers personalized rewards, reminders, or recommendations that keep them coming back.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
CART RECOVERY
 
Abandoned cart recovery that understands why
 
When a shopper leaves mid-checkout, ContactPigeon proactively re-engages to understand what held them back, from price to delivery concerns, and offers the right response to bring them back.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
POST PURCHASE SUPPORT
 
24/7 always-on personal concierge
 
ContactPigeon's Menura AI can act as a 24/7 concierge - answering questions, tracking orders, and recommending complementary products in the brand's own voice. Service feels instant and human.

 Speak with Retail Expert 
 
 
Trusted by 500+ brands globally. Rated Top Customer Satisfaction on G2.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Menura AI
 
 
 
 
The next generation retail AI brain, 
powered by your data
 
 
Menura AI is trained directly on your product data, customer insights, and brand voice. It helps shoppers find the right products, answers questions instantly, and drives conversations across every channel.
 
 
 
Product Knowledge
 
 
Conversational Commerce
 
 
Predictions
 
 
Support
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Product Knowledge
 
AI tuned to every customer
 
Menura AI uses deep CDP insights to understand each shopper's behavior, including lifetime value predictions, churn risk, past browsing patterns, and products ordered. It combines this historical context with real-time signals during the conversation, allowing it to predict intent, tailor responses, and guide the shopper with precision.
Every interaction reflects what the customer has done, what they need now, and what they're likely to want next, all delivered in your brand's voice.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Conversational Commerce
 
Conversion that happens in conversations
 
Turns every chat into a shoppable experience, from product discovery to adding items to cart and completing checkout. Menura AI guides shoppers through sizing, comparisons, availability, and recommendations, then seamlessly handles cart updates, order creation, and purchase completion.
Through conversation, Menura AI removes friction from the buying journey and makes purchasing feel as natural as talking to a helpful store associate.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Predictions
 
Predictions that keep your retail journey one step ahead
 
ContactPigeon uses AI to interpret rich CDP profiles and predict each customer's next move, including churn risk, repurchase likelihood, and propensity to increase spend. It accurately identifies behavioral clusters, future value, optimal timing, and product interest. These predictions drive proactive engagement and smarter automation, shaping experiences that feel personal and perfectly timed.
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
Support
 
Your most reliable support teammate, now infinitely scalable through AI
 
Menura AI acts as an extra customer support agent, delivering fast and accurate answers to inquiries and requests. It handles order lookups, returns, shipping updates, store details, and policy questions with ease, all in your brand's tone and personality. By resolving issues instantly and removing friction, it turns support moments into trust-building experiences that drive satisfaction and loyalty.
